svg.title: Time that the coupling adds when each step returns its spikes
svg.desc: Brunel network on 4 NEST threads; each exchange returns the spikes of its step. NCP 2 adds 36 to 119 µs with a Rust host and 68 to 160 µs with a Python host. NCP 1.0.1 adds 434 to 1,365 µs and 810 to 2,481 µs; with 10,000 neurons at 5 ms it was not run, because some steps exceed its 64 KiB frame. A raw round trip without a protocol takes 12 to 49 µs. Each point is the median of three blocks; its bar spans the block values.
